title: From Pakistan’s ateliers to your door.
text: Original Pakistani dresses, brought to Bangladesh by request. You choose the brand and the piece. We bring it to you.
imageNote: Editorial images, not items for sale

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: Find the dress you love from the Pakistani brand of your choice, then send us a link or screenshot with your size.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.text: We reply on WhatsApp with the price, expected timing and payment terms before anything is ordered.

steps.title: Receive
steps.text: Once you have agreed, we order the piece and arrange delivery to you in Bangladesh.
